newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Landstar System cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Landstar System cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst James Valentine said he cut his rating on Landstar System Inc to hold from buy, saying it had reached his 12-month price target in just two months.

-- "We are not changing our estimates and still believe the company will achieve 20 percent earnings growth from 1996 to 1997 based on improved industry fundamentals, contributions from recently acquired divisions, and easier comparisons to a harsh first quarter in 1996," Valentine said in a research note.
